RecipeSage API (v4.0.6)

Download OpenAPI specification:Download

Public REST surface generated from RecipeSage's tRPC router. Procedures are grouped by tRPC sub-router (tag).

discover

Browse and search the public discover recipe catalog

Request Body schema: application/json
required
searchTerm
string <= 255 characters
languages
Array of strings <= 20 items [ items <= 35 characters ]
categories
Array of strings <= 20 items [ items <= 255 characters ]
matchAllCategories
boolean
minRating
number [ 0 .. 5 ]
minRatingCount
integer [ 0 .. 9007199254740991 ]
photo
string
Default: "optional"
Enum: "optional" "required" "none"
sortBy
string
Default: "trending"
Enum: "trending" "newest" "topRated" "mostSaved"
offset
integer [ 0 .. 10000 ]
Default: 0
limit
integer [ 1 .. 100 ]
Default: 40

Responses

https://api.recipesage.com/compat/v2/discover/searchDiscoverRecipes
